name: state
description: Implements the State pattern in TypeScript with Vitest: state machines that swap behavior as state changes.

capabilities.name: ts-vitest
capabilities.description: Implement and test state machine examples.
commands: npm init -y && npm install -D typescript vitest

examples.output: Implements Draft/Review/Published states with guarded transitions and tests the full path.

examples.input: Refactor a switch-driven order status logic.
examples.output: Maps order statuses to state classes, moving transition logic out of the entity.
